description: Deterministic acquisition and integrity gates for private Instagram message imports.

cases.criterion: Google authorization remains refreshable for unattended checks, protected by PKCE and state, and limited to the read-only Drive scope.
A configured read-only Drive API pull overrides an explicit Drive Desktop path that has not materialized message files.
A stable Drive container accumulates every Instagram export packet while refusing unrelated Drive trees.
Message mirroring downloads only Instagram message subtrees and excludes unrelated account-export sections.
Scheduled Meta delta exports compose into one cumulative local message history instead of replacing earlier packets.
Freshness and completeness remain separate: incremental packets cannot be called full history until a verified all-time baseline is recorded.
A completed authenticated pull atomically advances the stable local Instagram mirror and records observable freshness state.
The cumulative completed provider set replaces stale bootstrap custody rows without duplicating sources, threads, or messages.
A failed or partial provider pull cannot replace the last completed local Instagram mirror.
The Instagram-only macOS LaunchAgent checks hourly and at login without pinning an online-only Drive Desktop path.
Manual and scheduled Instagram sync runs cannot overlap and race on the same private cache files.
The scheduler cannot be installed against a removable-volume workspace that macOS background privacy will deny.
macOS Spotlight results cannot split one exact export snapshot into duplicate nested import roots.
The same logical message remains one canonical row when overlapping exports change file pagination or array order.
A previously verified private cache remains usable when the provider pull is temporarily unavailable.
Instagram messages, participants, groups, media references, transcripts, and person capsules render from canonical state.
Repository-owned eval and script entries remain compatible with Localgraph workspace validation.
